boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented campus environments for individual work, research, writing, media projects, and supported academic study.

cards.entity_name: Main Reading Room, Friedsam Memorial Library
cards.title: Main Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Friedsam Memorial Library
cards.notes: Set up at one of the original tables and use the room’s long reading-room layout for a focused reading, outlining, or writing session.
cards.short_summary: A historic library room with original furnishings and a traditional reading-room setup.
cards.evidence_claim: The university describes the Main Reading Room as a classic room that retains its 1938 appearance and original tables and chairs.
cards.source_title: Newcomers to Friedsam Library | St. Bonaventure University
cards.access_notes: Friedsam resources are primarily for the SBU community; guests may be granted access under the library’s stated provisions.

cards.entity_name: First-Floor Collaborative and Private Workspace Area, Friedsam Memorial Library
cards.title: Friedsam First-Floor Workspace Area
cards.subtitle: Back of the first floor, Friedsam Memorial Library
cards.notes: Head through the archways into the first-floor back area when your task needs flexible seating for quiet solo work or a small collaboration.
cards.short_summary: A library area combining collaborative furniture with private workspaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The library says its first-floor back area has furniture for collaboration as well as private workspaces.
cards.source_title: Newcomers to Friedsam Library | St. Bonaventure University
cards.access_notes: Located in Friedsam’s first-floor back area; library resources are primarily for SBU community members.

cards.title: Friedsam Computer Lab
cards.subtitle: Back of the first floor, Friedsam Memorial Library
cards.notes: Use this named lab when you need a campus computer or want to send a print job wirelessly through the library’s Papercut workflow.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor library computer lab with printing support.
cards.evidence_claim: Friedsam directs students to the computer lab in the back part of its first floor and explains wireless print-job submission.
cards.source_title: Newcomers to Friedsam Library | St. Bonaventure University
cards.access_notes: Student printing guidance is provided by the library; computers may be prioritized for SBU students, faculty, and staff.

cards.entity_name: Digital Media Center, Friedsam Memorial Library
cards.title: Digital Media Center
cards.subtitle: Friedsam Memorial Library
cards.notes: Plan media-focused coursework here and confirm your project needs with library staff before relying on the center for a production session.
cards.short_summary: A library media facility for SBU-community use.
cards.evidence_claim: Friedsam Memorial Library identifies a Digital Media Center, and its guest-services policy restricts its use to the SBU community.
cards.source_title: Library Services for Guests | St. Bonaventure University
cards.access_notes: Use of the Digital Media Center is restricted to the SBU community.

cards.title: Friedsam Makerspace
cards.subtitle: Friedsam Memorial Library
cards.notes: Choose this library setting when your assignment benefits from making, prototyping, or working alongside a group rather than silent desk study.
cards.short_summary: A fully equipped makerspace within the library’s flexible study environment.
cards.evidence_claim: The university catalog says Friedsam offers flexible spaces, small-group study spaces, and a fully equipped Makerspace.
cards.source_title: General Information | St. Bonaventure University Catalog
cards.access_notes: Located in Friedsam Memorial Library; confirm equipment availability and any project-specific requirements with library staff.

cards.entity_name: Holy Name Library for the Franciscan Institute
cards.title: Holy Name Library
cards.subtitle: Connected to Friedsam Memorial Library
cards.notes: Use the collection as a research destination for Franciscan studies, and ask library staff about access to materials or any needed research support.
cards.short_summary: A connected special-collections library supporting Franciscan scholarship.
cards.evidence_claim: The university identifies the Holy Name Library as part of Friedsam’s Franciscan Institute collections and says it protects rare materials.
cards.source_title: Franciscan Institute & Holy Name Libraries | St. Bonaventure
cards.access_notes: Connected to Friedsam Memorial Library; rare materials are protected, so check with library staff before planning materials use.

cards.entity_name: Rare Books Wing Study Room, Friedsam Memorial Library
cards.title: Rare Books Wing Study Room
cards.subtitle: Friedsam Memorial Library
cards.notes: Arrange access when a class or research project calls for examining rare materials; this is a supervised study setting rather than a drop-in room.
cards.short_summary: A controlled study room for consulting rare materials and class sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: The university archives says the Rare Books Wing Study Room permits scholars to examine requested rare items and supports special class sessions.
cards.source_title: The Rare Books Facility | St. Bonaventure University Archives
cards.access_notes: The Rare Books Wing has highly restricted access; coordinate with library or archives staff for materials and room use.

cards.title: Writers & Publishers Room
cards.subtitle: Plassmann Hall 001
cards.notes: Bring a draft or publication idea and use the room’s print-making tools and reference materials for a hands-on writing or editing work block.
cards.short_summary: A study-and-creation room with publishing tools, typewriters, and a specialized library.
cards.evidence_claim: The university says the Writers & Publishers Room in Plassmann 001 offers Literary Publishing and Editing and English majors a place to study and create.
cards.source_title: Writers & Publishers Room offers unique resources to LPE students | St. Bonaventure University
cards.access_notes: Located in Plassmann 001; the university specifically describes it as a resource for Literary Publishing and Editing and English majors.

cards.title: The Learning Center
cards.subtitle: First floor, Plassmann Hall Student Success Center
cards.notes: Use the walk-in math support or schedule individual tutoring when a problem set needs feedback; pair the visit with your own course materials.
cards.short_summary: A centralized academic-support space with tutoring and walk-in math help.
cards.evidence_claim: SBU states that the Learning Center on Plassmann Hall’s first floor offers walk-in labs and individual tutoring for several mathematics courses at no cost.
cards.access_notes: Located on Plassmann Hall’s first floor. The cited math-support services are described as free; check current tutoring coverage before visiting.

cards.title: Writing Lab
cards.subtitle: Student Success Center, Plassmann Hall
cards.notes: Bring the assignment prompt and your current draft, then use the lab to work through questions at any stage of the writing process.
cards.short_summary: A Student Success Center writing-support space for drafts, process questions, and academic writing help.
cards.evidence_claim: SBU’s Composition Program says the Writing Lab in the Student Success Center can help with writing questions and challenges at any stage of the process.
cards.source_title: Resources for Students | Composition Program | St. Bonaventure University
cards.access_notes: The Student Success Center is in Plassmann Hall; ask the center about current appointment or walk-in arrangements.
